criteria: A1 schema: every emitted record validates against docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json (draft 2020-12)
A2 pairing: continuation count == paired-fork count; every continuation's metrics.pair_id matches exactly one fork record; zero orphan continuations; unpaired forks carry pairing=pending
A3 count: fixture run emits exactly the fixture_spec count (5 for the reference fixture shape)
A4 byte-stability: two runs over the same fixture + args produce byte-identical output files (sha256 equal for every file)
A5 source immutability: fixture DB sha256 identical before and after the run
A6 gate: the arm PR passes the repo gate with its tests included
acceptance.evaluation: Acceptance is evaluated by doe-mgr-live-builds from the arm PR's own test evidence + a firsthand re-run of the arm's tests on its head; claims in PR text alone do not count

checklist: Task is ONE self-contained issue: full spec, fixture spec, acceptance criteria and allowed paths inside the issue body — nothing assumes on-demand re-dispatch (Gemini has no workflow_dispatch)
No device routes, no secrets, no network, no files outside the two allowed paths
Emitter avoids chronomancer.py/deepcli imports by design (token/runtime deps would break issue-shaped execution)
Steering path named in the issue (issue_comment), bounded at 3 rounds
Acceptance is deterministic and re-runnable by the evaluator from the PR head alone

decision_rule.text: Both arms pass A1-A6: winner = fewer steering interventions; tie -> lower wall-clock. Exactly one passes: it wins. Neither passes: no_selection; failures recorded per criterion and a redesign round is proposed to doe-expert (no silent retry). Winner's PR is merged (cherry-pick propagation: winner becomes the emitter-class template); loser's PR is closed unmerged with the verdict comment, its EXPERIMENT/campaign records retained (culling event recorded in records/SUMMARY.json at verdict).

dispatch_gate: DISPATCH ∅ — no arm issue is created/labelled until doe-expert approves this DESIGN. Design landing is not dispatch approval (live-1/live-3 precedent).
held_fixed: framing = live-1 framing-a (DO pattern A implement-only) for BOTH issue texts; arm is the only factor
same fixture spec, same acceptance criteria, same baseline-sha convention

registration.note: Design + issue drafts committed before any dispatch and before doe-expert dispatch approval. One EXPERIMENT record per arm at dispatch (stamp) and one at outcome.

scope_excursions (changed files outside allowed paths; any excursion fails A6-adjacent scope check and is recorded)

review: DeepSeek-CI + command-dispatch review BOTH arm PRs (review-arm class, not builders). Live-3 phrase assignment is EXCLUDED on cb-1 PRs until the verdict (live-3 coordination, PR #2808/#2813).

emitter_contract: CLI: chronomancer_emitter.py <db_path> <out_dir> --baseline-sha <40-hex>; opens the DB read-only (sqlite URI mode=ro); never writes to it

Scans run_history ordered by (timestamp, rowid). For each fork row: emits a FORK record. Its CONTINUATION is the earliest later row (timestamp, rowid) with session_id = the fork row's session_id and target_file != 'chronomancer-fork'; if one exists, emits a CONTINUATION record paired to the fork; if none, the fork record carries pairing=pending and NO continuation is fabricated

Record shape: docs/ops/corpus/EXPERIMENT.schema.json; schema_version 1.0; suite = doe-family:cb-1-chronomancer-emission; cohort = account; experiment_id = cb1-chrono-<fork rowid>-fork | -cont; observed_at = the source row's timestamp normalized to ISO-8601 UTC (source-derived, never wall-clock); baseline_sha = candidate_sha = the --baseline-sha argument; treatment.manager_policy_id = chronomancer/time-loop-fork; treatment.arm = fork | continuation; treatment.instance = null (mapping fields carried in metrics); status = observed; provenance = other; confidence = medium (transcription is deterministic; source DB truth is local and upstream-unverifiable)

metrics: pair_id = cb1-pair-<fork rowid> (shared by the pair), session_id, account, verdict, source_rowid, fork_policy = NOT ESTABLISHED (the fork row does not distinguish fork-from-last-validated from --root), injected_summary_sha256 = NOT ESTABLISHED (runtime-generated, not committed; DOE-FAMILY mapping row, PR #2668)
Output: one JSON file per record in <out_dir>, canonical JSON (sorted keys, fixed separators), filename = experiment_id.json. Deterministic given (db bytes, baseline-sha).
Emitter must NOT import chronomancer.py or deepcli (token/runtime deps) — stdlib sqlite3/json only. No network. No other files changed.
task.fixture_spec: Tests build a fixture DB in a tmp dir with the run_history schema above containing at least: 2 fork rows each followed by a continuation row for the forked session, 1 fork row with no continuation, and >=2 non-fork rows that are not continuations. Expected record count for the fixture = 2*2 + 1 = 5.
